Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the father of Karan Johar is "Yash Chopra". This is a factual error; Yash Chopra was the father of Yash Johar, not Karan Johar. The Planner's own analysis in the same step admitted that the Karan Johar page states he is the son of "Yash Johar (not Yash Chopra)", yet the Planner contradicted this admission by stating the father is Yash Chopra in the "Updated Understanding" section. This hallucination propagated the error to the next step.
